newsitem.title: USA: UPS express volume rises 9.3% in Q3.
newsitem.headline: UPS express volume rises 9.3% in Q3.

text.p: Courier giant UPS said Wednesday the daily volume of its domestic and international express business rose 9.3 percent during the July-September quarter.
UPS said it handled an average daily volume of 1.6 million express packages. Domestic express volume which includes (UPS Next Day Air, 2nd Day Air and UPS 3 Day Select) grew 9.4 percent.
UPS said its international express traffic including its Worldwide Express, Worldwide Expedited, Euro Express and Euro Expedited, grew by 8.4 percent.
